payload.summary: Step 1 PO Triage confirmed skipped on 2 consecutive dev-team ticks (2026-08-06T19:37Z and 2026-08-06T20:07Z) — both times because the head-decoupled QA-Drain block's picked_batch was non-empty, firing its documented 'JUMP TO end # a batch was dispatched this tick; do not also fall through to Step 1/PO triage' clause (main.md line ~857). Review-Lane SECONDARY-Drain (the block immediately before it) always falls through regardless of outcome, but QA-Drain's own JUMP TO end overrides that fall-through for the whole tick.
payload.consequence: Step 0a-A/0a-D's pendingSignals[] (file + signal_queue rows tagged routed-to-po this tick) are marked processed/READ by the drain mechanism itself, but never actually reach po via Step 1's inline hand-off if QA-Drain's batch is non-empty same tick — and given review[]'s measured ~34/day net inflow and QA_CAP=10, a non-empty QA-Drain batch looks like it will be the COMMON case on busy ticks, not the exception. Signals are not lost from disk (processed/ + signals_processed DB retain them), but the intended same-tick delivery path to po is structurally bypassed whenever this fires.

occurrences.note: all 5 file-routed-to-po, 0 signal_queue NEW rows this tick

payload.not_yet_confirmed: Whether po has an independent discovery path for processed/routed-to-po signals outside dev-team's own Step 1 hand-off (e.g. its own periodic scan of docs/signals/processed/ or the signals_processed DB) — if such a path exists, this is lower severity (delayed delivery, not lost delivery). Router has not found evidence of one in this session; flagging for architect/po to confirm rather than asserting definitively.
suggested_fix_directions: Make the QA-Drain head-decoupled block's JUMP TO end conditional on pendingSignals[] being empty (i.e., still skip Step 1's own PO-triage-of-review-lane-rows logic, but always deliver pendingSignals via a lightweight always-run call regardless of batch outcome)

Or: decouple signal delivery from Step 1 entirely — a standalone always-run 'hand pendingSignals to po' step between drain-signals and the pipeline-resume/session-gate chain, independent of QA-Drain/SECONDARY-Drain outcomes
